bridge_summary.primary_bridge: RLM_SalesTransactionContext is the primary quote-runtime debugging bridge in wave 2 because its QuoteEntitiesMapping directly hydrates Quote, QuoteAction, QuoteLineItem, QuoteLineDetail, and QuoteLineRelationship.
bridge_summary.quote_header_mapping: QuoteEntitiesMapping -> SalesTransaction -> Quote is the primary quote header and pricebook bridge.
bridge_summary.quote_line_mapping: QuoteEntitiesMapping -> SalesTransactionItem -> QuoteLineItem plus QuoteEntitiesMapping -> SalesTransactionItemDetail -> QuoteLineDetail provide the primary persisted quote-line bridge.
bridge_summary.lifecycle_mapping: QuoteEntitiesMapping -> SalesTransactionAction -> QuoteAction and QuoteEntitiesMapping -> SalesTrxnItemRelationship -> QuoteLineRelationship are the primary lifecycle-facing mappings in scope for wave 2.
bridge_summary.waterfall_mapping: QuoteEntitiesMapping -> SalesTransactionItemDetail -> QuoteLineDetail is the clearest waterfall seam, with QuoteEntitiesMapping -> SalesTransactionItem -> QuoteLineItem supporting PriceWaterfallIdentifier linkage.
limitations: This summary fixture is the authoritative wave-2 normalized source and intentionally does not emit raw XML or a full metadata dump by default.
RLM_SalesTransactionContext is the only primary context-definition artifact in wave 2; this command must not pivot to RevSalesTransactionContext or BrowseProductsCtxDefinition.
The repo-tracked raw RLM metadata copy is stale relative to ARM, so checked-in raw XML is not treated as canonical for normalized output.
